# Linux x86 FFT backend; AVX2/FMA instructions stay in a separate object.
add_library(bsl_fft STATIC chowdsp_fft.cpp)
target_include_directories(bsl_fft PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_features(bsl_fft PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
set_target_properties(bsl_fft PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_compile_options(bsl_fft PRIVATE -ffp-contract=off)
include(CheckCXXCompilerFlag)
check_cxx_compiler_flag("-mavx2 -mfma" BSL_FFT_AVX2_SUPPORTED)
if(BSL_FFT_AVX2_SUPPORTED)
    add_library(bsl_fft_avx STATIC simd/chowdsp_fft_impl_avx.cpp)
    target_compile_features(bsl_fft_avx PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
    target_compile_options(bsl_fft_avx PRIVATE -mavx2 -mfma -ffp-contract=off)
    set_target_properties(bsl_fft_avx PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
    target_compile_definitions(bsl_fft PRIVATE CHOWDSP_FFT_COMPILER_SUPPORTS_AVX=1)
    target_link_libraries(bsl_fft PRIVATE bsl_fft_avx)
endif()
